svg.title: One Dollar is all you need story, scene 02: Every trade pays a fee
svg.desc: Under BUY, a silver coin turns into a pink token. Under SELL, a pink token turns into a silver coin. Both pay a 1% FEE, a big silver coin that splits into fifteen small coins. Ten go to a fireplace marked BURN, two go to a fountain marked POOL, and three go to a brass plate marked SQUARE HOLE.
